works.filename: James Whitbourn - A Brief Story of Peter Abelard.md

streaming.evidence: Opened the direct Spotify track page. Its title identifies “A Brief Story of Peter Abelard (Version for Soprano Saxophone & Organ)” and credits James Whitbourn, Gerard McChrystal, and Christian Wilson.

withheld: The cited UPV dissertation PDF was not retrievable in this pass; its accessible indexed text establishes the 1995 edition and the inspected p. 614 score excerpt does not show a composition year. The 1993 identity date therefore remains unsupported by opened evidence and composed is withheld.

composed.evidence: Hartley’s estate table, “Works for Saxophone by Walter Hartley,” has a Year column and lists African Dance (alto saxophone and piano, Dorn no. 199) as 1994. The University of Maryland dissertation’s “List of Twentieth-century American Duos for Woodwinds and Piano by Year” independently places African Dance under 1994 (https://api.drum.lib.umd.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/2153c64b-6b45-45aa-8f96-15586240afc5/content, printed pp. 51 and 65). This identifies a work/composition year, not a publisher or edition year.
